label: StudyE9-episodes latency setting (iii) JPEG upload, SENSITIVITY: model scores are the PNG scores; JPEG accuracy parity is pending StudyE10a. Only upload time (hence d_cloud) differs from setting (ii). Primary episode config only (k=2, q=0.75, L_max=10, c=0).

a_swap_resolver_to_4B.description: escalation-32B's code path run with 4B N1 resolver scores, 4B N1 thresholds and 4B N1 cloud latency must equal escalation-4B exactly.

b_shuffle_resolver_within_clip.description: resolver scores permuted across seconds within each clip (alarm FPR 5%, trigger 20%, primary config). AP at h <= 1 s must fall toward the base rate.

ap_curve_horizon_shift.note: CURVE SHIFT, NOT a per-event time: at the AP the 4B arm reaches at horizon h, this is how much further ahead the 32B arm reaches the same AP, by linear interpolation of the AP-vs-horizon curve. It says nothing about when either model first notices a given crash.

secondary_device_arm_4BI_N3.note: LABELLED SECONDARY. The Jetson Orin cannot sustain 4B N=3 at 1 Hz (StudyD4-orin: N=3 total latency p99 1.448 s, so its registered cadence is 2 s). These rows replay the arm at 1 Hz anyway, which is counterfactual, and charge StudyD4-orin's measured N=3 total p50 of 1.394 s as the device latency. They are not used for any decision rule.
